sents.zh: 明朝有两个很有名的人。
sents.en: The Ming dynasty had two very famous men.

sents.zh: 第一个人很喜欢草和树。
sents.en: The first loved plants and trees.

sents.zh: 他想知道哪些可以做药。
sents.en: He wanted to know which of them could be used as medicine.

sents.zh: 他走了很多路，看了很多山。
sents.en: He walked a great deal and saw many mountains.

sents.zh: 他用了差不多三十年，写成了一本书。
sents.en: He spent nearly thirty years and wrote a book.
The book held a great many plants and medicines.

sents.zh: 第二个人喜欢走路，也喜欢看山看水。
sents.en: The second loved walking, and looking at mountains and rivers.

sents.zh: 他去了很多别人没有去过的地方。
sents.en: He went to many places no one else had been.

sents.zh: 他每天晚上写下白天看到的东西。
sents.en: Every evening he wrote down what he had seen that day.

sents.zh: 他们两个人都做了一件事：多看，多写。
sents.en: Both men did the same thing: look closely, and write it down.
